title: Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: Spicy and fluffy empanadas featuring chicken and vegetable stock, perfect for a high protein meal, these empanadas are a show off Venezuelan dish, the use of papillote adds a nice touch to the presentation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, butter, and egg to make the empanada dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
In a separate bowl, mix the chicken breast, vegetable stock cube, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the hot sauce and bake for 20 minutes.
